scholarships.name: Foundation Scholarship (Schol)
scholarships.who: Trinity Senior Freshmen (2nd years)
scholarships.notes: Applications and attendance confirmation are now closed. 2027 exams run 4–8 January 2027. Scholars get free Trinity rooms, Commons dinner and a fee waiver for five years.

scholarships.name: Trinity Employability Bursary
scholarships.amount: Financial support to take up an opportunity
scholarships.who: Full-time Trinity undergraduates
scholarships.notes: Helps you afford an internship or work experience you've already secured. 2026 round ran March–April; students get an email when it reopens in 2027.

scholarships.name: Trinity & Three Ireland Connect to STEM Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Up to €5,000 per year (€20,000 over four years)
scholarships.who: Women in 1st or 2nd year of eligible Trinity STEM courses, resident in Ireland
scholarships.notes: 2026 round closed 19 Oct; results due December 2026. Need Irish residency for 3 of the past 5 years.

scholarships.name: Generation Google Scholarship: Women in Computer Science (Ireland)
scholarships.who: 1st or 2nd year undergraduates at a university in Ireland (2026–27)
scholarships.notes: 2026 round closed 5 Oct (or earlier once 80 applications arrived). Open to 1st and 2nd years, so a 2nd year can't apply again next year.

scholarships.name: SUSI Student Grant
scholarships.who: Students at Irish colleges who meet residency and means tests
scholarships.notes: Ireland's main means-tested grant. Applications open each spring for the following academic year.

scholarships.name: 1916 Bursary
scholarships.who: Students from groups under-represented in higher education
scholarships.notes: Applied for through your own college's access office.

scholarships.name: Trinity Sport Scholarship
scholarships.who: Talented athletes in Sport Ireland–recognised sports
scholarships.notes: Separate rowing and GAA scholarships also exist.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Irish Student Awards
scholarships.who: Irish citizens, or EU/UK citizens resident in Ireland 5+ years
scholarships.notes: Last cycle closed in October. Info sessions run each September.

scholarships.name: Huawei Tech4Her Scholarship
scholarships.who: Women in computing courses at TU Dublin, UCC and UCD
scholarships.notes: Not open to Trinity students: only the partner universities listed.

scholarships.name: TrailblazHER Scholarships (Intel)
scholarships.who: Women in STEM at TU Dublin
scholarships.notes: TU Dublin students. The 2026 round closed on Wed 18 Nov 2026.

scholarships.name: Intel Women in Technology Scholarship
scholarships.who: Women in technology degrees at partner universities

scholarships.name: 30% Club Ireland Scholarship (DCU Engineering & Computing)
scholarships.who: Women starting postgraduate study in DCU's Faculty of Engineering & Computing

scholarships.name: Trinity Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.who: New non-EU undergraduate entrants
scholarships.notes: For new non-EU entrants only.

scholarships.name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.who: Non-EU undergraduate and taught master's applicants

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship
scholarships.who: Non-EU students starting at an Irish institution
scholarships.notes: Confirm this year's dates on the HEA site.

scholarships.name: Irish Research Council Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.who: Research master's and PhD students in Ireland
scholarships.notes: Confirm this year's call dates on the funder's site.

scholarships.name: Becas generales del Ministerio (MEC)
scholarships.provider: Ministerio de Educación, FP y Deportes
scholarships.who: Estudiantes de grado y máster en universidades españolas
scholarships.notes: Plazo 2026/27: del 7 de abril al 18–19 de mayo de 2026. Para estudios en España.

scholarships.name: Becas de colaboración en departamentos
scholarships.who: Estudiantes de último curso de grado o de máster en universidades españolas
scholarships.notes: 2.111 becas en la convocatoria 2026-2027.

scholarships.name: Becas "la Caixa" de posgrado en el extranjero
scholarships.who: Españoles o portugueses que vayan a hacer máster/doctorado en Europa, Norteamérica o Asia-Pacífico
scholarships.notes: 100 becas. Ojo: quien haya terminado el grado en el extranjero antes de empezar la beca no es elegible.

scholarships.name: Becas "la Caixa" de grado
scholarships.who: Estudiantes que empiezan un grado en España
scholarships.notes: 60 becas, solo para quien empieza el grado.

scholarships.name: Becas Santander Erasmus
scholarships.who: Estudiantes de universidades españolas participantes con beca Erasmus+
scholarships.notes: 3.498 becas en 2026/27. No hace falta ser cliente del banco.

scholarships.name: Becas Santander Equality
scholarships.who: Alumnas de universidades españolas participantes
scholarships.notes: Inscripción 15 may–15 sep 2026 en Santander Open Academy.

scholarships.name: Becas Fundación Botín – Estudios universitarios
scholarships.who: Jóvenes de Cantabria con buen expediente y necesidad económica

scholarships.name: Becas de Excelencia Rafael del Pino
scholarships.who: Titulados superiores españoles
scholarships.notes: La web de la Fundación anuncia la próxima convocatoria para el 11 ene 2027; la fecha de cierre aún no se ha publicado (la anterior fue 9 ene–23 feb 2026).

scholarships.name: Becas Ramón Areces – Posgrado en el extranjero (Economía y Derecho)
scholarships.who: Ciudadanos españoles admitidos en un posgrado en el extranjero
scholarships.notes: Última convocatoria: 21 ene–23 feb 2026. También hay líneas de Humanidades y Ciencias de la Vida.

scholarships.name: Becas Barrié de Posgrado en el Extranjero
scholarships.who: Titulados universitarios vinculados a Galicia

scholarships.name: Auxiliares de conversación en el extranjero
scholarships.who: Graduados o estudiantes de último curso que quieran enseñar español fuera
scholarships.notes: En la edición anterior el plazo fue del 1 dic al 15 ene; la convocatoria 2027-28 aún no se ha publicado. Confírmala en el BOE. 700–1.870 €/mes según país.

scholarships.name: Becas de Excelencia Comunidad de Madrid
scholarships.who: Estudiantes en universidades de Madrid con expediente excelente
scholarships.notes: Fechas basadas en la última convocatoria (9–29 ene). Confírmalas en el BOCM.

scholarships.name: Becas Europa Santander – UFV
scholarships.provider: Universidad Francisco de Vitoria + Banco Santander
scholarships.amount: Programa de liderazgo + viaje por Europa
scholarships.who: Estudiantes de 2º de Bachillerato con expediente brillante
scholarships.notes: Para preuniversitarios: compártelo con hermanos o amigos en bachillerato.

scholarships.name: Becas Leonardo
scholarships.who: Investigadores y creadores culturales en España
scholarships.notes: Última convocatoria: 20 ene–20 mar.

scholarships.name: Becas SICUE Santander (movilidad nacional)
scholarships.who: Estudiantes en intercambio SICUE entre universidades españolas

scholarships.name: Undergraduate E3 Balanced Solutions for a Better World Scholarship
scholarships.who: Non-EU applicants with a first-year offer for E3 programmes, incl. Computer Science and Business
scholarships.notes: Only for non-EU fee payers entering first year; current students aren't mentioned. Needs a 200-word statement. Questions: e3.team@tcd.ie

scholarships.name: Palantir Women in Technology Scholarship (Europe)
scholarships.amount: Scholarship award + interview for Palantir internship
scholarships.who: Women studying CS / software engineering at a European university
scholarships.notes: Europe-wide, so Trinity students qualify. The 2027 round isn't open yet; the North American round has closed in March in past years.

scholarships.name: Bending Spoons Women in Computer Science Scholarship
scholarships.who: Women 18+ studying CS or related at a university in the EU, UK, Switzerland or Balkans
scholarships.notes: Europe-wide, so Trinity students qualify. Last round closed 6 April 2026; currently closed.

scholarships.name: Trinity Laidlaw Scholars Leadership & Research Programme
scholarships.provider: Trinity College Dublin Careers Service / Laidlaw Foundation
scholarships.amount: €3,500 stipend in each of two summers (research, then Leadership in Action), plus project and travel funding you can apply for
scholarships.who: Trinity undergraduates in 2nd year of a 4-year degree, or 2nd/3rd year of a 5-year degree or integrated master's
scholarships.notes: 2027 applications are OPEN until Tue 9 Feb 2027, 12 noon. 18-month programme: two 6-week full-time summer projects (research, then Leadership-in-Action) plus up to 7 days of in-person workshops in Dublin. You need a project proposal (self-defined with a supervisor, or one of two pre-defined projects), a leadership video, a Summer 2 proposal and the application form. You can only apply once. Students going on Erasmus can apply. Questions: employability@tcd.ie.

scholarships.name: J&J Winning in STEM²D Programme
scholarships.who: 2nd-year students in Trinity's Faculty of STEM
scholarships.notes: 2026 round closed 8 Oct: you applied through an email from Careers Service, and it takes about 32 hours between Nov and Apr. The article says it's open to all 2nd-year STEM students. Watch for the 2027 round in early autumn.

scholarships.name: Lectorados MAEC-AECID en universidades extranjeras
scholarships.who: Titulados con nacionalidad española, hasta 37 años, para dar clase de español en universidades extranjeras
scholarships.notes: La convocatoria suele salir a finales de diciembre, con solicitud en enero (última edición: del 13 al 30 ene). Fechas 2027 aún sin publicar.

scholarships.name: Ayudas de movilidad Luisa de Medrano (SICUE)
scholarships.provider: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades
scholarships.amount: 900 €/mes (hasta 8.100 € curso completo; +500 € si origen/destino insular, Ceuta o Melilla)
scholarships.who: Estudiantes de grado presencial en universidad española con plaza SICUE 2026-27, ≥60 créditos superados, nota media ≥5 y matrícula de ≥30 créditos
scholarships.notes: Primera convocatoria (curso 2026-27): 2.300 ayudas, 115 reservadas a estudiantes con discapacidad ≥33 %. Plazo: un mes desde el extracto en el BOE del 17 nov 2026 (hasta aprox. 17 dic). Se solicita en la sede electrónica del Ministerio con certificado de plaza SICUE, certificado académico, matrícula y empadronamiento. Solo para movilidad entre universidades españolas.

scholarships.name: Becas de doctorado INPhINIT "la Caixa" (Incoming y Retaining)
scholarships.amount: Contrato de doctorado de hasta 4 años + gastos de investigación y matrícula (cuantía exacta en las bases)
scholarships.who: Doctorandos de cualquier nacionalidad sin tesis iniciada ni más de 4 años de actividad investigadora. Incoming: ≤12 meses en España/Portugal en los últimos 3 años, solo STEM. Retaining: >12 meses, cualquier disciplina, doctorado en universidad distinta a la del grado.
scholarships.notes: 30 becas Incoming (cierre 12 ene 2027, 14:00) y 30 Retaining (cierre 2 mar 2027, 14:00). El doctorado se realiza en España o Portugal.

scholarships.name: Iveagh Fellowship Programme
scholarships.provider: Department of Foreign Affairs (via Trinity Careers Service)
scholarships.amount: €6,000 once an internship of 8+ weeks is secured and approved
scholarships.who: Irish citizens on an undergraduate or postgraduate (diploma/master's) programme at an Irish university, interested in international policy careers
scholarships.notes: The 2026 round hasn't been announced by DFA yet, and Trinity's dates are still to be confirmed. Funds an international-policy internship.

scholarships.name: Becas Fulbright de máster y doctorado en EE. UU. (Programa propio)
scholarships.amount: Viaje e instalación $1.300; hasta $4.300/mes; matrícula $35.000–40.000/año; seguro médico (convocatoria 2027-28)
scholarships.who: Españoles con título superior (obtenido entre ene 2019 y sep 2026 en la última convocatoria) que quieran hacer un máster o doctorado en EE. UU.; TOEFL iBT ≥97, IELTS ≥7 o Duolingo ≥125
scholarships.notes: La convocatoria para el curso 2027-28 cerró el 14 abr 2026. La del curso 2028-29 aún no está publicada (fechas e importes por confirmar). Comprueba en fulbright.es si aceptan títulos de universidades no españolas. Fulbright también tiene sesiones informativas.
